rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.summary_plain: In San Diego, landlords cannot use or obtain software that uses competitor data to set or recommend rental prices or occupancy levels. Tenants can take legal action if this happens.
rules.summary_plain_es: En San Diego, los propietarios no pueden usar ni obtener software que utilice datos de competidores para establecer o recomendar precios de alquiler o niveles de ocupación. Los inquilinos pueden tomar acciones legales si esto ocurre.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential rental properties in the City of San Diego.
rules.exemptions_text: Algorithmic devices used only to publish reports from historical data older than 90 days or public information, and devices used to set rental rates or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines are exempt.
rules.penalty: Tenants may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation. Prevailing tenants recover costs and attorney’s fees.
rules.quoted_span: (a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
